p-howlerbros-8169955950707.d: The Bruja Boardshorts are our staple boardshorts. A product of years of R&D, the Brujas skip the frills in favor of everyday simplicity and utility. We conjured up the brew with stretchy fabric to help you flex when you need it, draining front pockets and 8.5” inseam.

p-howlerbros-8169960374387.d: We use our Howler blended t-shirts as the canvas for classic Howler designs and original creations. Made with supremely soft cotton-poly blend for maximum comfort and style.

p-howlerbros-7795881148531.d: We love the Iquitos Overshirt because it’s like a swiss army knife for your travel bag. This thing works as a cover up for your post-surf brunch or you can layer it and pull it off at a nice dinner. It’s rugged enough for anything, but the chunky wide wale corduroy gives it an elegance that will make your mom think you have matured into a fine young man. The enlarged chest pocket with horizontal grain gives off the vibrations you need.

p-howlerbros-7849166078067.d:
Throw on your Quonset Camp Shorts and settle in for every session! New for spring 2025, we made them with ripstop cotton and blended in a touch of spandex so you can win every badge all summer long. Vintage-style melamine buttons provide tough closures and ample pockets make it easy to tote along your compass, G.O.R.P. and Swiss Army knife.
Fit Note: Style runs larger. We recommend sizing down from your normal Howler shorts size.

The Keenan is fall dressing at its most agreeable — a mid-scale check in warm chestnut brown and muted blue that reads rich up close and quietly refined from across the room. It's the shirt you reach for on a Saturday and keep on through dinner. Pair the Keenan with the Franklin 5 Pocket and boots for an easy, earthy fall look.
